description.message: Apple Mail's message list: buttons on the message under the pointer (read or unread, flag, archive, delete), conversations, contact pictures (mbp115 kit).

optHint.message: Thunderbird's own view settings still work; this switches a folder shown without threads back to threads.

optThreads.message: Group messages by conversation (every folder shows threads, collapsed)

optPictures.message: Show contact pictures next to messages (from the address book, else the initials)

optPreview.message: Show two lines of each message under its subject (read from the messages stored on this computer)

optBackspace.message: Backspace deletes the selected message (in the message list; Ctrl+Z brings it back)
